names.avg3_177: Estudiante de la Academia Luz de Gracia
names.avg3_178: Estudiante de la Academia Luz de Gracia

steps: No one mentioned that a Freelance Trekker also has to write papers!
Grace Light Academy in Emor is the largest and most prestigious school in Nova.
It's a true breeding ground for the elite and has produced countless famous figures across every industry.
Guess what? I got into Professor Canace's class.
Seriously? That Monolith Studies course everyone's dying to get into—the one with the lottery system?==W== Take me with you, I'm totally sitting in!
Don't you have another class during that time? If you skip and get caught, there goes your participation grade.
Yeah, you're right... Sigh, where's the luck?
Canace sure is popular with the students. Her commission for me...
Sorry to bother you out of the blue, ==PLAYER_NAME==. I'm working on a new paper about the Monolith.
Could you come to campus tomorrow so we could have a chat? I could really use your help.
Can I really be of any help? When I don't even remember who I am?
Huh?! You seriously expect me to buy that?
Whether you "buy" it or not, an F is still an F, even if you miss the passing line by just one point.
Yeah, one lousy point! Can't you just let it slide? Having to retake the exam because of one lousy point is just a waste of my time!
Let it slide?==W== If we started bending the rules for things like this, the whole world would've fallen apart by now.
Listen up. The clothes you wear, the customized Artifact vehicle you ride, even the luxury villa you live in...==B== Every one of those was built with strict numerical precision.
Do you really think it is just about adjusting a number? It changes everything here and there.
Who... Who cares about any of that!
Sigh... If you still don't get it after all that, then you're never going to make any progress.
What...!? Do you have any idea who my father is? How dare you talk to me like that!?
Galerius Licinius, a senior manager for Deepsea Finance in Philae.
Though born into a lesser branch of an old family, he built up immense wealth and a reputation to match.
Your father's all the way in Philae and arranged for you to study back home. If he saw you acting like this...
How do you know all that!? You're just a professor—how dare you investigate...!
I know everything about my students, from their daily routines to their family backgrounds. That's what you get from "just a professor."
Besides, you're just a kid who doesn't even know who your own professor is, and you try to throw your family name around to scare people.==W== Such a disgrace to your family name.
She doesn't even need to raise her voice. Her talk has its own strength... So intimidating.
Some people really are a lost cause. Looks like this branch of the Licinius family won't be making a comeback anytime soon...==W== Hmm?
Canace got surrounded by a mob of students!
Could it be that kid from earlier came back for retaliation?==W== I'd better go help—
P-Professor Canace! I'm your biggest, biggest, biggest fan—!!
I can't believe I ran into you here! I didn't get into your course. Would it be possible for you to offer a few more?
Professor Canace! Could I ... have lunch with you?
Professor! I have a question about the Monolith studies. Do you have a minute?
No need to rush~ I'll answer everyone's questions patiently. Please line up first.
Professor! We're freshmen and it's our first time meeting you! Can we get your autograph? Sign our uniforms, please!
Hmm... Sorry, uniform is a no-go, but something like notebooks would be alright...
Yeah, we have notebooks! Here, please!
Ah... And here I thought they came to retaliate. How silly of me.
But with so many people crowding around, there's no way to get close... Guess I'll just have to wait until Canace is done.
Alright, everyone, the next class is about to start. Make sure you make it on time.
With that, all the students start to disperse.
Whew... Even the freshmen showed up this time. Really was a bit too much.
And that's why they call you the most popular professor of Grace Light Academy.
Honestly... teasing others like that isn't very nice, you know?==W== But never mind. Since you're here, let's head to my office and get down to business.
I'll try to make it short.
I asked for you because I wanted your help with writing this—
"An Investigation and Theoretical Model of Magic Flow inside the Monolith"?
Yes, I'm studying the flow of magic inside the Monolith, hoping to build a basic model. But there are some data that are difficult to obtain, so all I have right now is a draft.
"When a Trekker uses magic inside the Monolith, does the total amount of magic in the world actually decrease"...? I don't really get it.
You know me—I'm insulated from all magic effects. I know nothing about it.
And that is exactly what I need from you. I've designed a magic circle to measure magic flow inside the Monolith, but my own magic always interferes in the measurement process.
So, if you come with me to the Monolith and activate the circle using this magic scroll, it'll keep other people's magic, including my own, from interfering with the results.
Hmm... That's fine but... I can't handle Stellaroids on my own.
Don't worry, I'll clear out all the Stellaroids on that floor ahead of time.==W== With me there, nothing will touch you.
I may be just a professor, but I do know several powerful attack spells. I regularly take dozens of students into the Monolith for fieldwork.
So dependable. No wonder all your students love you.
Hehehe... I wouldn't go as far as that...
Although... I don't think I've ever heard you mention that you can do attack spells?
Well... How should I put it? Some things are better left off the record. That's why it doesn't show up in any official documents.
Anyway, it's not that I can't fight. And I've got plenty of experience tackling the Monolith.
So put your mind at ease and just stay behind me.
The magic scroll is ready and the circle is set.
So, Canace... I'm counting on you.
Roger that. I'll go deal with the Stellaroids.
HEY, HEY, HEY! You can't sleep here! What about the Stellaroids up ahead?!
